issue.title: [tests/http/test_http_copy.py] Need to clean up the start_http_server.py and stop_http_server.py by the end of the case

failure.body:
**Description**

In test_http_copy.py, it will copy start_http_server.py and stop_http_server.py to the /tmp of ptf container while doing the test, but it doesn't clear up them. So if the subsequent cases(such as lag) also need to execute some files in /tmp, start_http_server.py and stop_http_server.py would be imported as well which will cause the PTF container loop forever in the function httpd.serve_forever(). All the subsequent cases will be blocked.

Need to clean up the files once the case is finished.
**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. run tests/http/test_http_copy.py
2. run pc/test_lag_2.py

Then the test will be tucked forever.

resolution.title: Issue #3901: Re-enable http/test_http_copy.py
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary:

This test was disabled due to an issue with temporary scripts being copied to the ptf container and never being cleaned up. This is resolved by adding a setup/teardown fixture that will remove those files from the ptf when the test finishes.

This issue is tracked in community here: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/3901

There was a proposed fix (https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/3896) that seems to have been abandoned (review comment never got addressed and it died). I cribbed that change as the basis for this one, and added the use of tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile for a little more robust tempfile handling.

Fixes #3901
